heard: Pluto has ice mountains as tall as the Rockies. NASA's New Horizons probe found these peaks are made of frozen water. They tower over a massive heart-shaped basin filled with nitrogen glaciers. This basin, Sputnik Planitia, is so smooth it lacks impact craters. The nitrogen ice churns like a lava lamp to stay fresh. While the surface stays young, Pluto's thin atmosphere is actually collapsing. Measurements from 2016 show the air pressure dropped by over 20 percent. That world is freezing its own sky into mountains of ice.
